title: Why She Built Stairs Into the Ceiling
sources: Wikipedia, 'Winchester Mystery House' and 'Sarah Winchester': widow of William Wirt Winchester (Winchester Repeating Arms); inherited about $20 million; bought an unfinished farmhouse in San Jose, California in 1886; building continued until her death in 1922; about 160 rooms; stairs that lead to the ceiling, doors that open onto walls; legend of spirits, disputed by historians
Mental Floss, '14 Haunting Facts About the Winchester Mystery House': staircase to the ceiling, door to a wall, window in the floor; the spirit legend has no solid evidence
History Hit, '10 Facts About the Winchester Mystery House'; ABC7 News, 'Top 10 mind-bending facts about the Winchester Mystery House'

lines.text: Why would anyone build stairs that lead into the ceiling?
Her late husband's family made the Winchester rifle,
and she inherited about twenty million dollars.
